findings.label: 409 self-heal claim is inaccurate
findings.description: Comments in handleExecutionServiceCall/UpdateExecutionWithRefetch and the commit message state that a 409 conflict self-heals on retry, but 409 maps to a non-retryable ConflictError and aborts the cycle; only the 500 path retries. Documentation-only, no behavioral impact. Fix the wording to match handleErrorResponse/errors.go.

findings.label: DLQ reason label unchanged for GET/validation aborts
findings.description: A GET failure or validation abort inside UpdateExecutionWithRefetch is recorded to the DLQ under reason 'execution-service failure' with attempts:1 from handleExecutionServiceCall. This matches prior behavior (the old code used the same label for both GET and validation failures), so it is not a regression; noted for awareness only.
